name: Helios-Nomad StormCore Down Parka — Splitback
description: A mid-thigh parka filled with synthetic down rated for -40C, featuring a full split-back panel with adjustable tension straps to accommodate geneware wings or large spinal rig hardware. The shell is a matte charcoal ripstop with bonded seams and a storm-flap zip system. Hood is removable and fur-trim optional.
functionality: Split-back panel opens to full wingspan clearance for geneware wings or accommodates external spinal rigs; rated -40C static, -30C in sustained lake wind.
what_it_says: Expensive enough to signal comfort, practical enough to mean business — and the splitback says they've modified their body significantly.
story_hooks: A Spire-level corponation logo has been carefully removed from the left chest — the ghost of the patch is still visible in the stitching.
The split-back tension system was custom-calibrated for a wingspan wider than any licensed geneware clinic would approve.
related_entities: ARCTURUS DEFENSE Bastion Subdermal Armor Mesh

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular mid-thigh parka with a dramatic architectural split down the back, creating two distinct panels that can be tensioned apart. The silhouette is deliberately asymmetrical when worn over augmentation hardware, reading as both utilitarian and avant-garde. Presents as a statement piece for those with significant spinal or wing modifications.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the torso with articulated seams; the splitback design allows the garment to expand and contract via adjustable tension straps. Tapered at wrists and hem for weather sealing. Designed to drape over cybernetic frames without restriction.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte charcoal ripstop synthetic composite with bonded seams; interior lined with synthetic down insulation rated -40C
physical_description.texture: Ripstop weave creates a subtle diagonal pattern under direct light; smooth matte finish on exterior, soft quilted down visible through the split-back panels when tensioned
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal grey primary; optional fur trim on hood in synthetic white or deep slate; interior quilted sections visible in cream or silver-grey
physical_description.closures: Primary storm-flap zip system with reinforced pull tabs; adjustable tension straps (magnetic snap or friction-fit) along split-back seams; detachable hood secured by friction clips
distinctive_features: Full split-back panel with dual adjustable tension straps for hardware accommodation
Bonded seams for durability in harsh weather
Storm-flap zip system with reinforced stops
Internal tech-compatible pockets (designed for subcutaneous port access)
Asymmetrical paneling that emphasizes augmentation silhouette
Helios-Nomad woven badge at left chest
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 crossover: premium workwear pricing with professional-grade materials, marketed toward augmented operatives with stable income
physical_description.cultural_context: Street-level cyborg culture, augmented laborers, wing-modded runners, spinal-rig technicians. Signals someone comfortable with visible modification and needing practical gear that doesn't hide it. Common in free-territory settlements and GLMZ industrial corridors.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn-in but maintained; minor scuffing on ripstop, creased seams, tension straps showing slight discoloration from repeated adjustment. Usually spotted with light weathering—rain stains, dust, occasional grease smudges—but never heavily damaged
